text: To talk to your crew on WhatsApp, open Integrations, then WhatsApp, and choose Open.
You connect WhatsApp once, for your whole account. On your phone, open Linked devices, and choose Link a device.
Scan the code, and give the number a name, so your crew knows who's writing.
Now just message them. Ask a question, approve a reply, or hand off a job, from wherever you are.
